final: WITH by_status AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans, SUM(sc.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS gb_per_minute FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), with_average AS (SELECT status, total_scans, gb_per_minute, AVG(gb_per_minute) OVER () AS average_gb_per_minute FROM by_status) SELECT status, total_scans, gb_per_minute, gb_per_minute - average_gb_per_minute AS above_average FROM with_average WHERE gb_per_minute > average_gb_per_minute
